shared_elements: human-like arms or hands on an upright figure/surface
horizontal bands or registers of decoration
justification: Both surfaces show a very similar repertoire of schematic relief figures: multiple profile animals, including quadrupeds and elongated snake- or bird-like forms, arranged on upright stone-like surfaces with some register-like organization and possible human arm/hand motifs. The biggest difference is that B presents a dense, clearly tiered composition with repeated signs and a prominent diagonal animal/serpent scheme, while A’s visible decoration is sparser and less legible, with fewer clearly corresponding motifs in the same positions.
